subject: Whistic bulk evidence ingestion: staging window & mapping
messages:
From: Lena Hoffmann <lena.hoffmann@vendorcorp.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Whistic bulk ingest — initial scope and staging

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for taking this on. We're prepping a large export of our Whistic profile (SOC 2 + SIG attachments) for ingestion into your Whistic profile. Before we push anything, two quick asks so we can plan: 

- Staging window: what 48-hour window works for you in the next two weeks for the initial bulk load? We want to avoid peak traffic.
- Ingest method: does Redwood prefer portal upload, signed S3, or an API-based bulk job for large archives (we're estimating ~450GB compressed)?

I've attached a small manifest template that mirrors our internal layout (whistic_manifest_template.csv) and a short PDF with our current export layout (s3_upload_instructions.pdf).

Also: can you confirm whether attachments stored in Whistic should map to CAIQ sections (e.g., A.4, A.5) or if you want a flat attachments list with metadata? We'll align naming accordingly.

If easier, propose two possible windows and we'll lock one.

Thanks,
Lena Hoffmann
VendorCorp — Trust & Security

Attachments: whistic_manifest_template.csv (csv), s3_upload_instructions.pdf (pdf)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Lena Hoffmann <lena.hoffmann@vendorcorp.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-29T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic bulk ingest — initial scope and staging

Hi Lena — appreciate the context and the attachments. Quick answers and a proposed plan below.

1) Staging window: we can do a controlled bulk ingest the week of Aug 2. Two candidate windows (pick one):
   - Tue Aug 3 02:00–04:00 PT (low traffic)
   - Thu Aug 5 22:00–24:00 PT (maintenance window)

2) Ingest method: for your size I'd recommend a temporary signed S3 bucket + manifest-driven import. We also support an API-based ingest for streamable payloads, but S3 is simpler for large binary attachments. We will automatically import attachments and map them to CAIQ/SIG sections if you include a column named "section_map" in the manifest.

3) Limits & lifecycle: single object size up to 50GB (multipart recommended), total bucket retention we can set to 30 days and then move to cold storage. If you need longer retention, we'll coordinate.

I've attached a small example mapping file (redwood_bulk_map_example.csv) that shows the expected columns: object_key, filename, section_map, control_ids, uploaded_by. Please use the Drive folder below to drop your final manifest and we'll generate the import job.

Drive (staging folder): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodBulkStaging

Action items for VendorCorp:
- Confirm window (one of the two above)
- Populate manifest using our example (redwood_bulk_map_example.csv)
- Confirm whether you want CAIQ mapping or flat import (we recommend CAIQ mapping)

CC'ing Priyom to help with access and Evelyn for QA sampling during the import.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Security Operations — Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_bulk_map_example.csv (csv)

From: Lena Hoffmann <lena.hoffmann@vendorcorp.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: security@vendorcorp.com, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-30T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic bulk ingest — initial scope and staging

Dylan — thanks, that all looks doable. We prefer the Tue Aug 3 02:00–04:00 PT window. A couple clarifications: 

- We'll do a one-time full export (~450GB compressed) followed by incremental (delta) uploads for two weeks.
- Vendor engineering is leaning toward an API-based push for deltas, but will do the signed S3 for the initial full export.
- We'll include the section_map column as you suggested and map to SOC2 controls + CAIQ sections.

Attached is our vendor_export_manifest.json (small sample) so you can validate the format on your side. We're happy to schedule a 30-min alignment call Monday if you want to walk through the mapping and lifecycle rules.

> Hi Lena — appreciate the context and the attachments. Quick answers and a proposed plan below.
>

Thanks,

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-31T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Whistic bulk ingest — staging window confirmed

All — per the vendor confirmation, we are set for Tue Aug 3 02:00–04:00 PT for the initial signed-S3 ingest. Summary and immediate next steps: 

1) Pre-load checklist (by Mon EOD Aug 2):
   - Vendor to upload manifest to Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodBulkStaging (Priyom will validate format)
   - Dylan to provision signed S3 bucket and send upload credentials to Lena
   - Evelyn to prepare QA sampling plan (10% random sampling + CAIQ mapping checks)
   - Marcus to confirm retention policy (30 days then cold) and lifecycle rule creation

2) Live window (Aug 3 02:00–04:00 PT):
   - We'll run import job and monitor errors (Jira SEC-482 for any anomalies)
   - If >1% import error rate, we will pause and triage

3) Post-ingest (Aug 3–5):
   - Evelyn to run QA and sign off export mappings
   - Vendor to provide MFA-proof snapshot for any accounts used during upload (mfa_snapshot.png)

Attachments: mfa_snapshot.png (png)

I'll provision the S3 bucket and share the signed upload link by EOD. CC'ing Marcus for retention confirmation.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Security Engineering — Redwood Inference
